user.title: Set up DB Info
user.description: Choose start and destination (a person or zone with coordinates) and the means of transport to use.

data_description.Startpunkt: Person or zone to search connections from. The entity's current coordinates are used.
data_description.Ziel: Person or zone to search connections to.
data_description.Verkehrsmittel: Which means of transport to include. "Custom" opens an additional step to pick individual ones.
data_description.Update Intervall: How often (in minutes) connections are fetched again.
data_description.Max_Umstiege: Maximum number of transfers per connection. "Unlimited" applies no limit.

data_description.Verkehrsmittel_Custom: Only connections using these means of transport are shown.

error.no_entities_with_coordinates: No person or zone entities with coordinates found.
error.cannot_connect: No connection could be found for this route. Check start/destination and try again.

abort.already_configured: An entry for this start/destination combination already exists.

refresh_all.name: Refresh all connections
refresh_all.description: Immediately refreshes all DB Info entries instead of waiting for their update interval.
